name: xander-plugins
description: Alexander Nguyen's Claude Code plugins — workflow skills for planning, orchestrating, and verifying agent work.

plugins.name: execute-plan-orchestration
plugins.description: Turn a multi-task implementation plan into right-sized subagent clusters: tag tasks by shape, group them, assign model tier and reasoning effort, and place review gates. Ships the plan-reviewer and implementation-test-reviewer agents that staff those gates.

plugins.name: xander-workflow
plugins.description: Engineering workflow skills: weigh design options, port reference algorithms rigorously, audit duplication, search code structurally with ast-grep, and write up a session.
